item.title: 用于射频电容耦合等离子体放电的分层自适应傅里叶特征物理通知神经网络
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Tong Wu, Jingyu Li, Senzhong Jiang, Qian He, Xingzhao Jiang, Yufeng Huang 等9位作者
物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 很难针对射频电容耦合等离子体流体泊松系统进行训练，因为缺少初始条件、陡峭的鞘层梯度和强烈不平衡的残差可能会导致不稳定或非唯一的重建。我们为此类耦合等离子体模型提出了分层自适应傅里叶特征 PINN (HA-FPINN)。该方法结合了傅里叶特征映射来改进小尺度鞘结构的表示，稀疏物理锚提供内部约束，以及两级自适应加权方案来平衡偏微分方程、边界和锚损失以及单个方程残差。该框架在 8 方程氦放电模型和 23 方程负电模型上进行了测试。

item.title: Validating Graph Neural Network Feature Attribution Through Local Perturbations: A Study on CoMoFeNiCu Decomposition Enthalpy
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Miguel Tenorio, James Chapman
arXiv:2611.18430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) show promise for predicting materials properties, but interpretability remains a challenge, particularly understanding whether attributed feature importance reflects physical reality or statistical artifacts. Here, we present a methods validation study that deliberately overfits a physics-aware GNN ensemble to probe the robustness of feature-ranking approaches. Using the CoMoFeNiCu high-entropy alloy system with three stoichiometries, we train GNNs to predict decomposition enthalpies from DFT-calculated structures while explicitly constraining output weights to encode feature importance. By design, our dataset is limited (approximately 900 binary and 4,500 ternary decomposition pathways) to control compositional…

In practice, however, the strength surface must be supplied as an analytic form chosen and calibrated case by case, and for the widely used analytic surfaces (n=2) accurate strengt…

item.title: 通过基于神经网络的多信号谐波处理增强超光谱纳米FTIR成像
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pablo Calvo-Barlés, Sergio G. Rodrigo, Luis Martín-Moreno, Martin Schnell, Rainer Hillenbrand
纳米 FTIR 光谱将红外光谱与纳米级空间分辨率相结合，实现高光谱纳米成像。然而，定量测量通常依赖于高次谐波近场信号，这些信号基本上没有背景，但信噪比 (SNR) 较低。较低的谐波可提供更高的信噪比，但包含显着的背景影响，会扭曲近场响应并阻碍定量分析。在这里，我们引入了一种交叉谐波神经网络（CHNN），它利用多个谐波通道中编码的互补信息来对三次谐波高光谱数据进行去噪。 CHNN 直接在实验纳米 FTIR 数据集上进行训练，使用一次和二次谐波光谱来提高三次谐波响应的 SNR。

item.title: Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
item.description:

arXiv:2611.18490v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atomistic foundation models have emerged as a promising route to DFT-level accuracy for materials simulation with complex chemical environments. However, their reliability across competing bonding regimes and, more importantly, how complex bonding affects predictions of material properties remain unclear. Among materials with competing bonding regimes, sodium storage in hard carbon poses a substantial challenge. Hard carbon features diverse local structural motifs, including defective and curved graphitic regions, amorphous regions, and closed/open pores. Motivated by its importance for Na-ion batteries, we systematically evaluate existing pretrained foundation models based on the MACE architecture across different local Na/C motifs. We fi…

item.title: Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models

arXiv:2611.17462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models have become strong priors over plausible crystal structures, but turning that prior into promising candidates requires steering toward several conflicting properties at once. Fine-tuning is expensive and produces a new model for every new objective, while differentiable guidance is not applicable to many real-world tasks. We instead adapt these generative models at inference time using Diffusion Tree Sampling (DTS), a Monte Carlo tree search procedure over the denoising trajectory. We make two technical contributions on top of DTS that are particularly relevant for AI-for-science applications. First, we show how to use existing property-conditional generative models (e.g., models fine-tuned for classifier-fr…

item.title: 通过机器学习力场和色散相互作用桥接 CsPbI₃ 钙钛矿的表面动力学和相变
item.description:
📚 Editors' Suggestions
👤 Iryna Knysh, Anton Charkin-Gorbulin, Claudio Quarti, David Beljonne, Igor Poltavsky, Alexandre Tkatchenko
作者：Iryna Knysh、Anton Charkin-Gorbulin、Claudio Quarti、David Beljonne、Igor Poltavsky 和 Alexandre Tkatchenko 在表面平板上训练的机器学习模型能否准确描述体相变？作者通过在立方 CsPbI 3 板配置上训练的模型证明了这一点，该模型重现了块状 CsPbI 3 中温度驱动的正交-四方-立方相变。作者表明，成对和超成对分散处理之间的选择会显着影响预测的相变。

arXiv:2611.17627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a machine-learning (ML) charge density model, DeltaChargeNet, integrated with the full-potential tight-binding muffin-tin orbital (FP-TB-MTO) method for electronic structure and quantum transport simulations of materials and devices. The ML model predicts electron density from atomic structures with low linear-scaling cost, while FP-TB-MTO provides an accurate tight-binding representation of the system Hamiltonian. To achieve high-fidelity ML density for complex devices with interfaces and disorder, we train an equivariant graph convolutional network to predict Δ ρ-the difference between DFT and atomic superposition densities-under a charge neutrality constraint required for inhomogeneous systems. item.title: CGTransformer：用于晶体生成和逆设计的拓扑感知自回归框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zhennan Zhang, Shaobo Yu, Haoting Zhang, Yu Han, Zhiyue Guo, Junjie Wang 等8位作者
自回归语言模型提供了晶体生成和逆向设计的统一途径，但其性能取决于周期性结构的序列化方式。对称等效且密切相关的晶体可以在基于坐标的序列化下接收不同的原子顺序，从而引入与其结构连接性无关的可变性。在这里，我们提出了 CGTransformer（Crystal Graph Transformer），这是一种自回归生成框架，它通过图嵌入排序策略来解决这一挑战。使用商图拓扑和重心嵌入，元素对称图 (ESG) 将周期性晶体网络转换为拓扑引导的一维序列，保留关键的局部和对称相关的结构信息。

item.title: 一种用于对能源材料中的小极化子动力学进行采样的机器学习辅助工作流程
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tavinder Singh, Harald Oberhofer
大多数能量材料（例如用作电池电极、光伏材料或光催化剂）的一个显著特征是其能够传导电荷，如电子和空穴。这种导电性的确切机制取决于材料，但通常由移动小极化子的存在主导，即通过其环境的极化而强烈局域化的电子或空穴。在计算方面，可以通过使用自相互作用校正或混合密度泛函理论（DFT）以及局部几何优化，以合理的精度处理小极化子。可以采用类似的方法来确定小极化子通过跃迁运动的能垒。遗憾的是，现实的能源材料往往具有非常大量的对称性不等价的极化子构型，以及相应的大量跃迁势垒，因此难以明确处理。

However, current research mainly concentrates on compositions close to equimolar alloys, leaving a large part of the composition space unexplored. Here, we develop a multiscale framework based on a data-driven dislocation genome method that constructs energy landscapes for edge dislocation motion across various compositions. The local configurational force derived from the energy landscape is incorporated into dislocation dynamics simulations, revealing a scaling law connecting macroscale strength and atomic-scale local resistance governed by fluctuations in the local configurational force. item.title: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yezeyuan Zheng, Ziyang Hu, Maojun Sun. Ruijian Han, Jian Huang, Guanhua Chen, Jie Liu
arXiv:2611.18043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experimental optimization of perovskite solar cells is constrained by combinatorial diversity in absorber compositions, device layers, and processing, which makes virtual screening attractive for prioritizing recipes before fabrication. We develop a surrogate-guided reinforcement-learning framework that casts recipe generation as virtual screening, enriching candidate shortlists near high-performing experimental neighbors. A frozen Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN) guides recipe generation, while a reference pool of 890 measured devices enables neighborhood-based assessment. Five-fold evaluation on 1,846 devices shows top-ten selection raises mean power conversion efficiency (PCE) from 19.68% to 23.74%. Three learned policies are co…

item.title: 基于样本的量子对角化中参数选择的人工智能
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Doriela Grabocka, Dimitrios Christofidellis, Federico Zipoli, Anna van Elst, Patrick Ruch, Antonio Foncubierta-Rodríguez 等8位作者
基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法提供了一种计算分子基态能量的方法，但其准确性和运行时间敏感地取决于配置选择，例如子空间维度、传播时间步长以及跨电路的固定采样预算分配，而对于这些配置选择不存在正式的选择方法。在这项工作中，我们探索预言模型是否可以根据哈密顿量和候选配置预测量子运行时间和近似误差。

arXiv:2611.18497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an approach to solving locally ordered quantum spin systems using neural network quantum states. First, our approach rests on choosing a spin basis constructed from the magnetic texture of a classical or quantum reference state. Second, the method improves convergence and suppresses parameter-space drift through a regularized Riemannian gradient descent adapted to the quantum state geometry of the variational state manifold. Combining these techniques enables stable ground-state calculations for two- and three-dimensional chiral spin systems with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions. item.title: 基础张量网络在量子晶格系统中推广
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ryan T. Grimm, Michael Lindsey
神经量子态和张量网络已成为模拟量子多体系统的领先技术。然而，无序系统在这两个框架中仍然极具挑战性，因为它们需要为无序的每次实现计算基态。最近，神经量子态已被用来构建直接从哈密顿量生成基态的基础模型。尽管如此，他们仍然受到需要进行大量采样来估计可观测值的阻碍。为了解决这些困难，我们引入了基础张量网络（FTN），它使用神经网络从哈密顿量生成基态波函数的张量网络表示。

item.title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
item.description:

arXiv:2611.17539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous crystal-structure determination from powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) remains a key bottleneck for self-driving materials laboratories. We formulate the task of pXRD structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem: candidate structures can be assessed during inference through forward-simulated profile agreement and during evaluation through structural matching to a known reference. To benchmark progress, we introduce pXRD-Bench, a suite of 200 simulated single-phase problems spanning in-distribution structure determination, challenging and polymorphic structures, and controlled compositional and topological distribution shifts. Agent adaptation raises selected structural recovery from 27% to 69%, with further gains f…

item.title: 分段反应堆上线νₑ探测器中基于拓扑的快中子背景抑制和惰性中微子灵敏度
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Roni Dey
反应堆电子反中微子通常通过逆β衰变相互作用来检测，先是瞬发正电子，然后是延迟中子俘获。在浅层或地上分段有机闪烁体探测器中，相关快中子是主要背景，因为质子反冲可以模拟瞬发 IBD 信号。我们使用用于反应堆反中微子探测器的印度闪烁体矩阵作为案例研究来研究基于拓扑的机器学习。多层感知器根据详细的 Geant4 模拟重建的拓扑可观测量进行训练。 mathrmF₁ 分数和独立验证样本上的 bootstrap 重采样产生 PIBD>0.40 的固定阈值。

arXiv:2611.18140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fast charging of lithium-ion batteries is a multi-objective control problem that requires reducing charging time and sustaining high energy throughput while suppressing accelerated degradation and safety-critical electrochemical reactions. Conventional protocols are easy to implement but have limited ability to adapt to variations in battery chemistry, operating conditions, and aging state. Model-based optimization and conventional data-driven control often require accurate models, costly iterative search, or task-specific policies. We develop a large language model (LLM)-empowered intelligent agent for adaptive battery fast-charging control. item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Narsimha Rao Elaprolu, Marco Gibertini
arXiv:2611.18525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling band topology in magnetic semiconductors requires strategies that couple electronic structure to experimentally accessible degrees of freedom. Here we propose a cooperative approach based on pressure and magnetic reorientation in A-type antiferromagnetic bilayers. Antiparallel layer magnetizations suppress hybridization between exchange-polarized band-edge states, limiting their response to interlayer compression. A magnetic field that aligns the layer moments removes this spin mismatch, enabling pressure-enhanced hybridization to drive a band inversion. arXiv:2610.18185v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In first-principles calculations of metallic systems, the discrete electronic mesh in the Brillouin zone necessitates a smearing function and its width (e.g., the widely used 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton scheme) to enforce continuity of energy and occupation at the Fermi surface. item.title: Controlled Magnon Chirality and Its Reversal by Anisotropy in Altermagnetic FeF₂
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 E. M. Smith, V. O. Garlea, D. Lederman, J. M. Tranquada, I. A. Zaliznyak, J. Sears
arXiv:2611.18182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In altermagnets, the exchange symmetry of two mutually compensating magnetic sublattices permits spin-polarized electronic bands and chirality-split magnon bands. Because these effects have opposite signs in domains related by time reversal, magnetic-domain control is essential for their observation and utilization. Using half-polarized neutron diffraction, we demonstrate that we can control magnetic domain imbalance in a single crystal of FeF₂ by field cooling, and we relate this response to the established piezomagnetism in this material. Our half-polarized inelastic neutron scattering measurements directly resolve the altermagnetic splitting of chiral magnon bands. item.title: Exotic superconducting states in altermagnets
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kirill Parshukov, Andreas P. Schnyder
arXiv:2507.10700v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between magnetism and superconductivity is one of the central topics of condensed matter physics, which has recently been put into new light by the discovery of altermagnets. Here, we study this interplay from a fundamental symmetry perspective using irreducible co-representations of the altermagnetic spin-point groups. We construct and tabulate all symmetry-allowed pairing functions for altermagnets, which uncovers numerous exotic pairing states. We focus on three of them, namely: (i) a non-unitary ``altermagnetic superconductor'' with different spatial anisotropies for the spin-up and spin-down condensates, (ii) a ``half-and-half metal-superconductor" where only electrons with one of the two spin components form Cooper pa…

item.title: 从δf到全f回旋流体动力学的有限拉莫半径涡流相互作用
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Manuel Rinner, Franz Ferdinand Locker, Markus Held, Alexander Kendl
我们研究二维等温模型中的有限尺寸静电陀螺流体涡流对，重点关注有限拉莫尔半径效应以及从局部微扰到有限幅度全分布动力学的转变。基于帕德离子陀螺平均的有效响应核在拉莫尔半径尺度上正则化短程欧拉相互作用，同时保留其对数远场，从而产生轨道频率的有限核心预测。局部模型扫描表明，增加相对于电子温度的离子温度会增强陀螺旋转和丝状化，并驱动从合并到长寿命共同旋转的分离依赖性转变。长波长模拟再现了预测的有限拉莫尔半径引起的轨道角频率下降，对应于涡旋对旋转的明显减慢。

item.title: 协调全球和本地自旋模型
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bendegúz Nyári, András Lászlóffy, László Szunyogh
基于第一性原理计算的磁相互作用可以转化为全局自旋模型（其中相互作用与构型无关），也可以转化为局部自旋模型（其中有效参数明确取决于底层的自旋构型）。尽管这两种观点往往会得出看似不一致的结果，但我们证明，通过将分析限制在横向自旋涨落上，可以使它们协调一致。我们开发了一种投影方案，该方案可系统地从局部相互作用矩阵中去除虚假的纵向贡献，从而在投影的局部相互作用与潜在的全局多自旋哈密顿量之间建立起严密的联系。

item.title: Uniaxial strain induces d-wave phonon chirality in ferroelectric BaTiO₃
item.description:

arXiv:2611.18402v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circularly dichroic resonant inelastic x-ray scattering has revealed electrically switchable g-wave phonon chirality in freestanding BaTiO₃ membranes. Lowering C₄ᵥ to C₂ᵥ adds a d-wave helicity that is bilinear in the orthorhombic strain η and the polarization, with nodal lines along the stress axis. item.title: Altermagnetism across the BCS-BEC crossover
item.description:

item.title: 量子电磁学简明入门
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wei E. I. Sha
本书面向受过经典电磁学训练的读者，向他们介绍量子电磁学，并不假定读者具备量子力学的系统性背景知识。核心问题是，何时经典描述就足够了，何时必须明确保留物质或场的量子态。从熟悉的电磁模式和材料响应出发，讨论了原子动力学、场量子化以及量子化场与量子物质的相互作用。特别关注的是，如何将从经典电磁计算中获得的模态分布、格林函数和散射矩阵引入量子模型。原子相干性、光子统计、自发辐射和腔耦合是通过推导来阐述的，这些推导确定了每种描述的物理假设和局限性。

item.title: 来自IMAP、SOLAR-1和L1星座的行星际激波对地球的多尺度分析
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Savvas Raptis, Drew L. Turner, Domenico Trotta, Vassilis Angelopoulos, James L. Burch, Dibyendu Chakrabarty 等31位作者
无碰撞激波是整个宇宙中粒子加速的主要场所。在这些激波周围形成的瞬态介观结构会影响它们的能量转换效率，但在行星际（IP）激波中仍然很少被观察到：航天器对激波转变进行短暂采样，单点测量无法将时间演化与空间结构分开。在这里，我们研究了 2026 年 1 月 19 日由 CME 驱动的快速 IP 冲击，由 L1 的 IMAP、SOLAR-1、Wind、ACE、DSCOVR 和 Aditya-L1 以及地球附近的 ARTEMIS 和 MMS 观测到，以确定其空间和时间结构。

item.title: 全各向异性波导中TE/TM完全分离的充要条件
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wei Jiang, Jie Liu
建立了均匀填充完全各向异性和无损介质的波导中完全横向电/横向磁（TE/TM）可分离性的充分必要条件。介电常数和磁导率张量是埃尔米特正定的，并且可以包含非零横向-纵向耦合项。当且仅当横向磁导率块与横向介电常数块的转置成正比并且相应的横向-纵向耦合矢量在复共轭后满足相同的比例关系时，才会发生完全的 TE/TM 分离。除了正定性之外，纵向本构条目保持独立。该条件直接从无源麦克斯韦方程导出，并且对 TE 和 TM 模式的独立分析得出相同的材料关系。

item.title: 光子超晶体中的反螺旋边缘态
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ke-Yi Zeng, Zi-Xuan Gao, Zhou Zhou, Xiao-Dong Chen, Jian-Wen Dong
反螺旋边缘态代表边界输运的无间隙形式，其中具有相反自旋的模式沿着给定边界反向传播，而共享相同自旋的模式在相反边界上以相同方向传播。在这里，我们表明，这种状态在具有交错双各向异性的电磁双光子超晶体中实现的改进的 Kane-Mele 框架内自然出现。反转一个亚晶格上的自旋相关的次近邻耦合将体光谱重新组织成自旋极化的狄拉克半金属，其特征是狄拉克锥体的自旋相关的能量变化而不是体能隙。这种块体重组在锯齿形带中产生倾斜边缘模式色散，并引起与块体状态共存的反螺旋边缘输运。

item.title: 使用射频连续波扫描 NV 磁力测量在数十兆赫范围内进行轴选择性交流磁场成像
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shuntaro Komuro, Ryusei Okaniwa, Kazuma Okura, Kunitaka Hayashi, Toshu An, Junko Ishi-Hayase
空间分辨磁场成像揭示了微电子器件中的材料特性和局部电流。传统的脉冲扫描氮空位 (NV) 磁力测定 (SNVM) 面临着日益严格的微波 (MW) 脉冲控制要求，用于检测频率范围为数十到数百兆赫的射频 (RF) 磁场。为了应对这一挑战，我们为 SNVM 实施了 RF 连续波 (CW) 传感方案，并演示了 33.5 MHz 的交流磁场成像。
